title: The Horn Supremacy @ Lindbergh's!
seo_title: The Horn Supremacy Brass Band at Lindbergh's, Springfield
description: The Horn Supremacy, a 9-piece contemporary brass band, plays a pre-holiday party at Lindbergh's, with music starting at 8:30 and a $10 cover. Guests are encouraged to wear dancing shoes. It takes place on November 21, 2026 (Time TBD) at 318 W Commercial St in Springfield, MO.
